title: [W]Upload your file of documents
p1: [W]Once you've read the orders from the tribunal, make sure:
bullet1: [W]you have the set of documents in one PDF file
bullet2: [W]that if an index is requested, the items are in date order or an order in which the tribunal have requested
bullet3: [W]the index item refers to the correct page in the document
bullet4: [W]you only include relevant documents and material for your case
bullet5: [W]the PDF document falls within any page limits given by the tribunal
p2: [W]If you're referencing one section of a document like a contract of employment, say which part in the index.
